en.headline: Hang Seng Index closes up 132 points for third consecutive gain
en.dek: The benchmark ended at 23,525.97 on Tuesday, rising 0.57% on turnover of more than HK$236 billion as consumer and gaming stocks led gains.
body: The Hang Seng Index closed 132 points higher at 23,525.97 on Tuesday, a rise of about 0.57%, marking its third straight day of gains. The index traded in a range of just over 200 points during the session and finished near the day's high.
Turnover on the main board rose to more than HK$236 billion. The Hang Seng Tech Index gained 0.7% to 3,867 points, while the Hang Seng China Enterprises Index rose 0.5%.

Consumer stocks posted some of the larger advances, with Haidilao and Trip.com each up more than 6%. Gaming shares continued to climb, with Sands China and Galaxy Entertainment rising more than 3%. Property and utility stocks were also higher.

On the other side, some artificial intelligence concept and chip stocks declined, while pharmaceutical and oil shares were weaker. The market's rise came as mainland Chinese indices ended lower after recent policy measures failed to reverse a broader slide.

zh.headline: 恒生指數高收132點 連升三日
zh.dek: 周二收報23525.97點，升幅近0.6%，成交額逾2364億元，消費及博彩股帶動升勢。
body: 恒生指數周二收市報23525.97點，升132點，升幅約0.57%，連升三日。全日高低波幅略多過200點，最終接近全日高位收市。
主板成交額增至逾2364億元。恒生科技指數升0.7%至3867點，恒生中國企業指數升0.5%。
消費股升幅較大，海底撈及攜程集團均升逾6%。博彩股持續向上，金沙中國及銀河娛樂升逾3%。地產及公用股亦上升。
另一方面，部分人工智能概念股及晶片股下跌，醫藥及油股亦向下。港股上升之際，內地股市在近期政策措施後仍然低收。
